title: PART3 Frostbound Chronicles Deckbuilding game im making with ai .
author: Mobile-Bedroom9175
selftext: Here i want to show you guys one of my elite enemies Goblin Shaman .  His special is seperating into 2 different units after hp theshold.

comments.author: West_Satisfaction299
comments.body: Looks cool, anything unique you are trying to do with this game?

replies.author: Mobile-Bedroom9175
replies.body: Yes ! There will be 5 uniqe classes . Horizontal map with free selection node  movement . You can reach act boss in feew nodes or you can explore all.  But there will be time pressure which empowers enemies. We got rune system you can impelent in to your desired card  . Also there will be seperated special event locations like extraction . You can obtain totaly procedural created special cards and other things afterxompleting and escaping the location!

comments.author: ibDABIN
comments.body:
Honestly this looks pretty good but I can't help but see this as a fake game they would play in a TV show or a movie. Like, it looks like a game that would appear in an ad that doesn't show true gameplay...does that make sense?

Anyways, love the perspective and direction of this but would suggest maybe working on that uncanny appearance the character model has. The enemy models look good to me and so do the cards and even the UI is pretty solid but your character model is just...off. Sorry I don't have the ability to articulate it better!

replies.author: Mobile-Bedroom9175
replies.body: Thank you for feedback ! You mean the player character at left with spear right ?

comments.author: BeltwayBro
comments.body: Animations look really smooth. Is there a public play link? Would love to give this a try if so.

replies.author: Mobile-Bedroom9175
replies.body: Thanks ! Not yet but im working on about releasing a demo

comments.author: Square-Yam-3772
comments.body:
it looks weird when the enemies are facing in the same random direction (not at the camera, not at the player controlled character)

the indicator on top of their head are centered on the sprites. it would look better if it is directly on top of the actual heads instead

actually, the game looks pretty nice (someone mentioned the fake game ads aesthetic and yeah... you nailed that look)

replies.author: Mobile-Bedroom9175
replies.body: Yes i also think that can fix it later on . Glad if you liked the general look of the game

replies.author: Square-Yam-3772
replies.body: I personally prefer this look over mishandled pixel art look (I am guilty of mishandling pixel art in one of my projects so)
